data.title: ‘If it wasn’t for ChatGPT my brother would still be alive...
data.description: After Megan Enneking’s brother died by suicide, his family discovered months of disturbing conversations with ChatGPT. An Observer investigation, drawing on exclusive testimony from OpenAI insiders, reveals serious gaps in the company’s efforts to protect its users and the wider public
data.author: Patricia Clarke, Katie Gunning
data.keywords: Artificial intelligence, Mental health, Science & Technology, OpenAI, Investigations
